implementation: Select scoped DeclaredUtf8 only when the upstream capability macro is available; preserve bundled behavior otherwise and surface legacy Unicode profile observations.
Use a QString for the DIMSTYLE default to select the intended overload.
Reject malformed or nonzero insertion units for R12/R14 before output is opened, set an error and display the reason; omit only a well-formed unitless value. Reset the error for a subsequent export.
Correct an invalid LTYPE group-72 fixture and make the test helper handle pre-name application metadata.
